source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne Carrollton publishes 45 MW of IT capacity, the third-largest disclosed data center load in Texas and 9.5 percent of the state's 475 MW published total.

Assuming 40 kW per rack, that capacity translates to roughly 1,100 racks, or 4,400 to 8,800 H100-equivalent accelerators depending on configuration. The certifications, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FISMA, ISO 27001, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942, qualify the site for regulated workloads, but none are specific to AI, and the operator does not publish which tenants occupy the space.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, yet only 19 publish power figures. This campus is one of that small transparent set, meaning most of the state's data center load remains undisclosed and any estimate of total grid demand is incomplete. The site's suitability score is 71 out of 100, with announced expansion missing from the inputs.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
